title: Certificates of Deposit: how the opening deposit may be funded
content:
## Scope

This card covers how the opening deposit of each Certificates of Deposit tier may arrive: whether the tier requires new money, which funding sources are accepted, and the funding window within which the opening deposit must post.

## Definitions

- **New money required** states whether the opening deposit must come from outside Piedmont Crescent Bank (PCB), that is, not by an internal transfer from a PCB account.
- **Accepted funding sources** are the ways the opening deposit may arrive. The possible sources are: a transfer from a PCB checking account, a transfer from a PCB savings or money market account, an ACH transfer from an account at another bank, a check, cash at a branch, and an incoming wire.
- **Funding window** is the number of calendar days after opening within which the opening deposit must post.

## Funding rules by tier

| Tier | New money required | PCB checking transfer | PCB savings transfer | External ACH | Check | Cash | Wire | Funding window (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | No | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | 10 |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | Yes | Not accepted | Not accepted | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | 10 |
| 12-Month Certificate | No | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | 10 |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | No | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | 10 |
| 36-Month Certificate | No | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | 10 |
| 60-Month Certificate | No | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | 10 |

## Same rules, stated by source

- **External ACH, check, cash and wire** are accepted on all six tiers.
- **Transfers from a PCB checking or PCB savings account** are accepted on five tiers and are not accepted on the 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate, the only tier that requires new money.

## Points of judgement

**A customer wants to open an 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate by moving money from a PCB savings account. Is that an accepted source?**
No. That tier requires new money, which rules out any internal transfer from a PCB account, and its accepted sources are external ACH, check, cash and wire.

**The same customer offers a wire from another bank instead. Is that accepted?**
Yes. An incoming wire is an accepted source on every tier, including the 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate.

**Is the funding window different for any tier?**
No. Every tier allows 10 calendar days after opening for the opening deposit to post.
